blind.description: A stylized fantasy idol or fountain featuring several vibrant purple tentacles with pink suckers emerging from a round, segmented grey stone base decorated with purple circular gemstones. The surfaces are smooth, continuous, and solidly modeled in a hand-painted game art style without floating fragments or unintended holes.
blind.from_above: A circular stone ring base enclosing a cluster of curled purple tentacles with visible pink suction cups, casting curled tentacle shadows to the upper left.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: circular segmented stone basin/plinth integrated into the idol
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3.5 to 4 ft tall) and roughly 2.5 to 3 ft wide across the base.

notes: aspect ratio somewhat wider than catalog target but reads well as a tentacle idol
